description: This file defines a validation rule class 'Currency' within the OrangeHRM system. The class extends an abstract rule and implements a method to validate whether a given input string represents a valid currency code, primarily by checking if the input exists as a currency entity via a service.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A validation rule class for checking if a given input is a valid currency code based on existing currency entities.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the provided input string is a valid currency code by verifying its length and existence in the currency database.
